# Craftwork Home

> Craftwork is a design-build studio in East Kensington, Philadelphia, led by Jayme Guokas. One team designs, builds and makes: adaptive reuse, whole-house renovations, kitchens and baths, cabinetry and built-ins, and custom furniture made in its own shop. It serves Philadelphia, the surrounding towns and South Jersey.

## Pages

- [Home](https://craftworkhome.com/): who Craftwork is, featured projects and client reviews
- [Work](https://craftworkhome.com/work.html): the full portfolio, filterable by category
- [Services](https://craftworkhome.com/services.html): adaptive reuse and general contracting, renovation, kitchens and baths, built-ins, custom furniture, and ways to work together
- [Process](https://craftworkhome.com/process.html): the five project stages and answers to common questions (cost, timing, permits, working with an architect)
- [Contact](https://craftworkhome.com/contact.html): inquiry form with budget ranges per service

- Principal: Jayme Guokas
- Location: East Kensington, Philadelphia, PA
- Areas served: Philadelphia, surrounding towns and South Jersey
